$comment: Machine-readable routing for the retrieval-by-need skill. Claude reads this to decide which chapters to load for a task. ALWAYS apply SKILL.md core (rules + decision order) without loading anything. Then load ONLY the chapters mapped below. Never bulk-load the chapters/ folder.
always_apply: SKILL.md core: non-negotiable rules + 6-step decision order + language rule

routing_notes.rebuild-audit-page: Load 07 only if custom code is actually found or explicitly requested.
routing_notes.00: Chapter 00 is the full build rules. The SKILL.md core already summarizes it; load 00 only for deep rule detail.

chapters.load_when_en: You need the full, canonical version of the native-first rules and decision order.
chapters.load_when_ro: Ai nevoie de versiunea completă a regulilor native-first și a ordinii de decizie.

chapters.load_when_en: You need to pick the right native Avada element for a section (design, layout, form, inline, or WooCommerce elements).
chapters.load_when_ro: Trebuie să alegi elementul nativ Avada potrivit pentru o secțiune.

chapters.load_when_en: You need a section-by-section blueprint for a page type (B2B, local business, portfolio, SaaS, corporate).
chapters.load_when_ro: Ai nevoie de o structură pe secțiuni pentru un tip de pagină.

chapters.load_when_en: You need site-wide settings: colors, typography, layout width, header/footer strategy, forms, performance, custom CSS panel.
chapters.load_when_ro: Ai nevoie de setări la nivel de site: culori, tipografie, lățime, header/footer, formulare, performanță.

chapters.load_when_en: You need to specify desktop/tablet/mobile behavior: breakpoints, responsive option sets, column stacking/order, responsive typography.
chapters.load_when_ro: Trebuie să specifici comportamentul pe desktop/tabletă/mobil.

chapters.load_when_en: The site has a contact form, lead capture, quote request, newsletter opt-in, or spam/GDPR consent needs.
chapters.load_when_ro: Site-ul are formular de contact, captare lead-uri, cerere de ofertă, abonare newsletter sau consimțământ GDPR.

chapters.load_when_en: The project includes an online store: shop/archive, single product, cart, checkout, my account, product filters.
chapters.load_when_ro: Proiectul include magazin online: shop, produs, coș, checkout, cont, filtre.

chapters.load_when_en: Custom development is genuinely required: child theme, action/filter hooks, PHP, when native Avada truly can't do it.
chapters.load_when_ro: Este nevoie real de dezvoltare custom: child theme, hooks, PHP, când Avada nativ chiar nu poate.

chapters.load_when_en: You need on-page SEO and AI/answer-engine visibility: keywords, entities, FAQ, schema, internal linking.
chapters.load_when_ro: Ai nevoie de SEO on-page și vizibilitate în motoarele AI: cuvinte cheie, entități, FAQ, schema, linkuri interne.

chapters.load_when_en: You need reusable/global blocks or site-wide templates: Avada Library, Global Elements, Avada Layouts & Layout Sections, conditions.
chapters.load_when_ro: Ai nevoie de blocuri reutilizabile/globale sau șabloane la nivel de site: Bibliotecă, Global Elements, Avada Layouts.

chapters.load_when_en: You need EN<->RO terminology mapping, or rules for handling a bilingual (English UI, Romanian body) build.
chapters.load_when_ro: Ai nevoie de corespondența termenilor EN<->RO sau de reguli pentru un proiect bilingv.

templates.load_when_en: Starting a concrete project — fill this in before /avada-plan.
templates.load_when_ro: La începutul unui proiect concret — completează înainte de /avada-plan.
